content_of_post_to_answer: How can I stop overthinking every small situation?
answer: Overthinking is often not a thinking problem; it is an attempt to create certainty where life only offers probabilities. The mind keeps replaying small situations because it believes one more analysis will prevent discomfort. A better question is: “Is this thought helping me act, or only helping me feel temporarily in control?” I’ve explored this pattern more deeply in my profile for those who want to understand it further. The goal is not to stop thinking, but to stop treating every thought as a problem that needs solving.
